children.characters: Three steps to a frictionless night out.

children.name: Guests scan the table QR with any smartphone camer
children.characters: Guests scan the table QR with any smartphone camera — no app download, no account required. They land directly on your branded menu.

children.name: A rich, photo-led digital menu lets guests browse,
children.characters: A rich, photo-led digital menu lets guests browse, customise, and add to their order at their own pace — no rushed interactions with staff.

children.characters: Guests pay by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay directly from their phone. Receipts are instant. Your staff never touch a card machine again.
